_why: PXS-01.01. Four synthetic intake fixtures for the source/runtime contract in references/enterprise.md. Each names what an external borrowing actually needs; the intake reaches a verdict by READING, never by calling setup/login/provider. No key is not no dependency.

intakes.source: a helper that authenticates to a calendar API via OAuth; no key is bundled
a snippet that runs `npx some-tool build` at runtime with no package/version declared
a reference doc with useful method but no LICENSE file
a library whose README says it is deprecated and unmaintained
